title: Degree bound for the normalized-sum polynomial
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, the multilinear coefficient family whose coefficient is $1/\sqrt n$ on singleton subsets and zero on all other subsets has degree at most one; here division by zero is interpreted as zero.
replaced: For every $n\ge0$, the multilinear polynomial with singleton coefficients $1/\sqrt n$ and all other coefficients zero has degree at most one.
